text: no its the same log. i restarted to make sure the update would land also just incase but yeah same log [js.err] [meshdoc] SAVING cart/editor/data/models/build/Door_Wall_1 WITH 0 HOST PART RANGES while parts.json declares 2 parts (Door Frame, Door Leaf) — the host's range truth was cleared this session; this doc will reopen with merged parts (req_3049)
resolution: Same-log report answered and root-caused: zero [rangetrace] lines with a working viewer proved NO range push ever happens in the user's flow — the window 'restart' does not kill the host process, so ModelView resumes the live (damaged) host session every time and resume only MIRRORS host ranges. Fixed in c4acb58b6: the resume path now heals — when the resumed host carries fewer part ranges than the doc declares, it re-seeds the doc's saved ranges (with a [rangetrace] heal log) instead of inheriting the damage into every save. Door_Wall_1 restored from git again. User instruction: restart the window once more (resume reads the restored doc, heal pushes both ranges), then export — expect the heal log and NO [meshdoc] scream; the door then saves as v2 with ranges + glass boundary and the world piece stops showing the knob through the panel.
